1.text: Yesu amaze kuvuga ibyo, yubura amaso areba mu ijuru ati “Data, igihe kirasohoye, ubahiriza Umwana wawe ngo Umwana akūbahishe,

2.text: nk'uko wamuhaye ubutware ku bantu bose, kugira ngo abo wamuhaye bose abahe ubugingo buhoraho.

3.text: Ubu ni bwo bugingo buhoraho, ko bakumenya ko ari wowe Mana y'ukuri yonyine, bakamenya n'uwo watumye ari we Yesu Kristo.

4.text: Nakūbahishije mu isi, kuko narangije umurimo wampaye gukora.

5.text: Na none Data, imbere yawe unyubahirishe cya cyubahiro nahoranye ndi kumwe nawe isi itararemwa.

6.text: “Abo wampaye mu isi mbamenyesheje izina ryawe. Bari abawe urabampa, none dore bitondeye ijambo ryawe.

7.text: None bamenye yuko ibyo wampaye byose byaturutse kuri wowe,

8.text: kuko amagambo wampaye nayabahaye na bo bakayemera, bakamenya by'ukuri ko naturutse kuri wowe, bakizera kandi ko ari wowe wantumye.

9.text: “Ndabasabira. Sinsabira ab'isi, ahubwo ndasabira abo wampaye kuko ari abawe,

10.text: kandi ibyanjye byose ni ibyawe, n'ibyawe na byo ni ibyanjye kandi nubahirijwe muri bo.

11.text: Jye sinkiri mu isi ariko bo bari mu isi, naho jye ndaza kuri wowe. Data Wera, ubarindire mu izina ryawe wampaye, ngo babe umwe nk'uko natwe turi umwe.

12.text: Nkiri kumwe na bo, nabarindiraga mu izina ryawe wampaye. Narabarinze, muri bo nta muntu wabuze ngo arimbuke, keretse umwana wo kurimbuka ngo ibyanditswe bisohore.

13.text: Ariko none ndaza kuri wowe, kandi ibyo mbivuze nkiri mu isi, ngo bagire umunezero wanjye wuzure muri bo.

14.text: Nabahaye ijambo ryawe, kandi ab'isi barabanga kuko atari ab'isi, nk'uko nanjye ntari uw'isi.

15.text: Sinsaba ko ubakura mu isi, ahubwo ubarinde Umubi.

16.text: Si ab'isi nk'uko nanjye ntari uw'isi.

17.text: Ubereshe ukuri: ijambo ryawe ni ryo kuri.

18.text: Uko wantumye mu isi nanjye ni ko nabatumye mu isi,

19.text: kandi nanjye niyeza ku bwabo ngo na bo babe bereshejwe ukuri.

20.text: “Sinsabira aba bonyine, ahubwo ndasabira n'abazanyizezwa n'ijambo ryabo,

21.text: ngo bose babe umwe nk'uko uri muri jye, Data, nanjye nkaba muri wowe ngo na bo babe umwe muri twe, ngo ab'isi bizere ko ari wowe wantumye.

22.text: Nanjye mbahaye ubwiza wampaye, ngo babe umwe nk'uko natwe turi umwe.

23.text: Jyewe mbe muri bo nawe ube muri jye, ngo babe umwe rwose, ngo ab'isi bamenye ko ari wowe wantumye, ukabakunda nk'uko wankunze.

24.text: “Data, abo wampaye ndashaka ko aho ndi na bo bahabana nanjye, ngo babone ubwiza bwanjye wampaye, kuko wankunze isi itararemwa.

25.text: Data ukiranuka, ab'isi ntibakumenye ariko jyewe narakumenye, n'aba na bo bamenye ko ari wowe wantumye.

26.text: Nabamenyesheje izina ryawe kandi nzaribamenyesha, ngo urukundo wankunze rube muri bo, nanjye mbe muri bo.”
